flows:
Navigate to https://www.calculator.net/date-calculator.html then Work exclusively inside the Reading view dialog.
Use only its listed roles, names and controls.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
In Reading view, first assert that the exact row ‘textbox · Days to add’ is present.
Set that textbox to 2 in Add to or Subtract from a Date.
Activate the Calculate control for that section, then verify the displayed date is two days after the start date.
